intent_summary: Explicit relationships produce ratio, difference, normalized-residual, and joint-condition series with source-level lineage.

criteria.criterion: Ratios retain the computed value, formula, and original source indexes for each sample.
Differences, supplied-scale residuals, and all/any threshold conditions produce the declared derived values.
Missing sources and zero denominators remain unavailable with a reason rather than becoming zero.
Derived series can be analyzed with the frozen or adaptive single-resolution recipe.
